name: Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH) Hairpulling Scale
directions: For each question, choose the one statement that best describes your behaviors or feelings over the past week. If they varied, estimate an average and read every response option before choosing.

questions.text: Frequency of urges: On an average day, how often did you feel the urge to pull your hair?
Intensity of urges: On an average day, how intense or strong were the urges to pull your hair?
Ability to control urges: On an average day, how much control did you have over the urges to pull your hair?

scale.label: Always controlled them, or had no urges
Could distract myself most of the time
Could distract myself some of the time

questions.text: Frequency of hair pulling: On an average day, how often did you actually pull your hair?

scale.label: So often it felt almost constant

questions.text: Attempts to resist: On an average day, how often did you try to stop yourself from actually pulling your hair?

scale.label: Tried to resist almost all of the time
Tried to resist some of the time

questions.text: Control over hair pulling: On an average day, how often were you successful at stopping yourself from pulling your hair?

scale.label: Resisted almost all of the time

questions.text: Associated distress: During the past week, how uncomfortable did your hair pulling make you feel?

scoringProfile.note: The supplied form contains seven 0-4 items. No diagnostic cutoff is supplied.
